description: Report on the user's task in its own thread: phase "plan" (what you are about to do), "progress", "blocked" (what stops you - the validator is told), or "done" - which marks the task done and hands it to its validator, who checks it on the site. Write it in the user's words and language, as them; it is marked as written through an agent. For "done", verifySteps are for the validator, who may not be technical. Only for a task that is the user's (claimTaskTool first). It never validates - that is the validator's click. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#reportTaskTool

links.description: http(s) links: the PR, the commit, a preview.

remaining.description: What is left for a later task.

summary.description: What was done, planned or is in the way. Plain text.

verifySteps.description: How the validator checks it, one step per item.

name: reportTaskTool
